Just to add: l

Unified Folders don't unify.

Automatic checking of email for new mail? Doesn't work. Set it for 15 minutes, never checked unless I forced it to sync.

Mail arrives in Gmail. Never shows up in Thunderbird even on a forced sync.

UI is slightly confusing, but I can give that a pass. Not a bug.

There were other issues that I didn't jot down.

Anyway, sorry to rant, but I had high expectations for this app and it really let me down.
